title.narrative: A CORE CONTRIBUTION TO SUPPORT GISHA’S 2023 WORK PLAN AND BUDGET FOR THEIR ACTIVITIES IN THE OCCUPIED PALESTINIAN TERRITORY (OPT).

description.narrative: The Tel Aviv-based Israeli NGO Gisha: Centre for the Legal Protection of Freedom of Movement focuses its activities on the right of freedom of movement of Palestinians, particularly those in Gaza. Since its establishment, Gisha has worked closely with Palestinian human rights NGOs in Gaza. Gisha has developed a new three-year Strategic Plan. Gisha will focus during the coming three years (2022-2024) on tackling the following strategic objectives:1) Bureaucratic obstacles on movement of people and goods are removed;2) Public audiences, partners, and opinion-shapers understand, recognize, and act against the harm caused by Israel's movement restrictions in Gaza, seeing Israel’s broader system of oppression and apartheid; and3) Israeli and foreign policy-makers pressure Israel to remove restrictions on movement to and from Gaza based on recognition of Israel's obligations to residents of Gaza, opposition to the fragmentation of Palestinians and Palestinian territory, and accountability to Palestinians.
